meta.name: A Shop for Killers
meta.description: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

videos.title: Murthehelp
videos.overview: Jian, who is helplessly attacked in her own home, dodges the flying bullets.

videos.title: Jeong Jinman, Jeong Jinman, Jeong Jinman
videos.overview: Jinman receives an unexpected call. Jian, who is alone at home, is pursued by unidentified men.

videos.title: The Strong Don't Howl
videos.overview: Jian finds herself in danger as she searches for a rescue phone in the mountains to save Jinman.

videos.title: The Shopping Mall
videos.overview: Jian and Jeongmin flee from the killers and meet Brother in the underground shopping mall.

videos.title: Babylon
videos.overview: Jian gets angry as she watches Jinman on the screen, and Jeongmin points a gun at Jian's head.

videos.title: Jeong Jinman
videos.overview: Jinman, who was once a mercenary of a large company, Babylon, suffers from the truth he learns.

videos.title: Trap
videos.overview: Bale, who was presumed to be dead, begins his revenge, and Jinman fights back to protect Jian.

videos.title: Listen Up, Jian
videos.overview: Killers close in on Jinman's house. Jian prepares for the final duel on her own.

meta.slogan: His hidden past, her deadly inheritance.
